AiGenerationRecord.title: AiGenerationRecord
AiGenerationRecord.description: Stores AI-generated Instagram scenarios, slides, captions, SEO/AEO/GEO articles, and sales campaigns created by a signed-in Google user in Arka Studio.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

productId.description: Selected Arka product identifier from arka-acc.ir

title.description: Human-readable title of the generated scenario, article, or campaign

contentJson.description: Serialized JSON payload of the generated AI content

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the generation was saved

UserPreferenceRecord.title: UserPreferenceRecord
UserPreferenceRecord.description: Per-user non-sensitive UI theme and connection mode preferences.

BrandProfileRecord.title: BrandProfileRecord
BrandProfileRecord.description: Per-user reusable Brand Intelligence Hub profile for Arka Studio content generation.

/users/{userId}/aiGenerations/{genId}.description: Private per-user collection of AI-generated Arka campaigns, SEO/AEO/GEO articles, Reels scripts, and slides.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Private per-user settings documents (preferences and brandProfile).
